name: sentinel-zero-viewer
description: Standalone 3D viewer for Sentinel-Zero's graph.json export. Built fresh for this project -- no dependency on, and no code shared with, any other visualizer in this account's portfolio (e.g. CodeVerse). Loads a graph.json produced by `sentinel-zero analyze`, lays it out in 3D with a simple force simulation, and renders it with Three.js so a reviewer can see which modules/functions carry which disposition at a glance.
